libvgmPlaybackSmoke.game: Action Man: Search for Base X

operationalNote: The 458 MiB droplet OOM-killed an in-place search-index refresh and also killed a Gunicorn worker during an online backup. The search index was rebuilt off-server and installed after SQLite and catalog size/mtime verification; gallery generation ran with the web service stopped. systemd restarted the service after both OOM events, and the final service and indexes are healthy.
